subtopic: Foreign Market Information and Legal Risks
source_evidence: If U.S. investors have a problem with their investment, they may not be able to seek certain legal remedies in U.S. courts as private plaintiffs.
answer: **Legal remedies can differ when investing internationally.** If a U.S. investor has a problem with an investment in a non-U.S. company, they may not be able to pursue certain remedies in U.S. courts. Even a successful U.S. court judgment may not be collectible against a non-U.S. company, so investors may need to rely on legal remedies available in the company’s home country, if any. This is one legal risk to consider when learning about foreign investments.
